ads.description: $125 OBO 15lb, single-hand drill, fewer than 5 games The Storm Rocket A.I. brings back a name bowlers have trusted for years, now reengineered to match the demands of modern lane conditions. It’s the ideal choice when you need added control up front without sacrificing backend pop. At the heart of the Rocket A.I. is the proven Booster Core, now upgraded with A.I. Technology. This enhancement fine-tunes the core dynamics by lowering the RG and increasing differential, creating a more dynamic shape downlane while maintaining the smooth, readable motion that made the original Rocket so dependable. The result is improved continuation and better carry, even on less-than-perfect hits. Wrapped around the core is the A1S Pearl Reactive coverstock, featuring Storm’s Adhesion System technology. Combined with Power Edge Polish, this cover clears the fronts with ease while still providing the traction needed to respond quickly to friction. The motion is clean, controlled, and angular—giving bowlers the confidence to open the lane when conditions start to break down. The Rocket A.I. is built for those moments when the lanes begin to transition, and you need a ball that gets down the lane effortlessly and finishes strong—helping you stay ahead of the transition and keep the strikes coming.

ads.author: Lane Lebouef
ads.title: Limited Edition LED Zeplin pinball
ads.description: Led Zeppelin Limited Edition Pinball Machine by Stern Formed in London in 1968, Led Zeppelin consisted of vocalist Robert Plant, guitarist Jimmy Page, bassist and keyboardist John Paul Jones, and drummer John Bonham. Together they became one of the best-selling bands with estimated record sales of 300 million units worldwide. In 1995 Led Zeppelin was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame for their innovative and influential impact on the entire music industry. In this high energy rock and roll pinball concert experience, pinball and music are fused together. Players are transported back to Led Zeppelin’s early days and tour the world from 1968-1980. As if players were members of the band playing its music, their play updates game features at the start of each verse and chorus of ten iconic Led Zeppelin songs: Good Times Bad Times Whole Lotta Love The Song Remains the Same Rock and Roll Trampled Under Foot Ramble On Kashmir Immigrant Song Black Dog Communication Breakdown “There is nothing more energizing and fun than bringing pinball and music together,” said Gary Stern, Chairman and CEO of Stern Pinball, Inc. “Partnering with Led Zeppelin, we created a one-of-a-kind pinball experience. It’s our dream goal to create a pinball machine with this iconic rock band.” The Pro, Premium, and Limited Edition models all feature a custom-molded Hindenburg Zeppelin toy, based on the iconic imagery from the Led Zeppelin I album. When lit, the Zeppelin toy scores speed locks on the player’s musical journey to Zeppelin multiball. A custom Swan Song Records trademark Icarus sculpted leaper toy takes flight when smashed by the chaotic pinball. A 3-bank of drop targets, 3 custom steel ramps, and 3 flippers keep the pinball action rolling. The Premium and Limited Edition models feature an innovative interactive Electric MagicTM toy. This device is a unique motorized toy which rises from below the playfield to create different magical pinball experiences. An optical spinner charges the Electric Magic magnet, capturing and making balls disappear. The Electric Magic device also converts into a physical pinball bash toy capable of locking a ball or launching a ball aroundthe playfield. In true rock concert fashion, the Expression Lighting SystemTM with 96 intelligent RGB LED’s enables full color spectrum control. Positioned in pockets cut into the cabinet sides to provide color themed full playfield illumination, this integrated playfield lighting system is synchronized to custom light shows specifically designed for every song and dynamically responsive to game events. As an encore, these models have an additional reversing scoop and metal combo ramp, allowing players to keep the hits coming with constant adrenalized pinball action. A back panel mounted illuminated song status board indicates which Led Zeppelin song is in play. Only 500 Limited Edition games will be made for sale throughout the world. This limited version includes an exclusive Icarus themed full color mirrored backglass, exclusive custom themed cabinet artwork, custom high gloss Paradise Shimmer Blue powder-coated armor, a custom autographed bottom arch, exclusive custom art blades, upgraded audio system, anti-reflection pinball glass, a shaker motor, and a sequentially numbered plaque.

ads.description: Key Details & CharacteristicsFunction: Venues used tokens like this in mechanical arcade games, batting cages, pinball machines, or carnival rides instead of cash. Design Features: It features a double border of stars, a standard motif used by token manufacturers to distinguish play coins from legal tender government currency. Material: It is struck in a silver-toned metal, typically a nickel-silver alloy or stainless steel, built to withstand heavy wear inside coin-op machines. Condition: The green spots near the center are verdigris, a natural patina/corrosion that forms on copper-based alloys (such as brass or nickel-silver) when exposed to moisture over time.

ads.author: Carl Coutts
ads.title: 1975 Bally Knockout Pinball Machine / same kind Elvis owned. ( very rare low play vintage pinball )
ads.description: Up for sale is a true "time capsule" specimen of pinball history: an all-original, fully maintained 1975 Bally Knockout electro-mechanical (EM) pinball machine. The same pinball machine Elvi owned at Graceland. Finding a 1970s EM game is easy; finding one that looks and plays like it just rolled off the Bally factory floor 51 years ago is nearly impossible.This machine is graded at a strict 9.0 out of 10 collector condition and features an incredibly low, verified odometer count of just 16,xxx lifetime games played. Unbelievably Low Mileage With just over 16,000 lifetime plays, the internal stepper units, scoring reels, and mechanical linkages have experienced almost zero friction or stress. It plays incredibly crisp, fast, and exactly as the engineers intended.100% Factory Original: This is not a heavily modified or reproduction-heavy restoration. This is a pristine survivor. It retains its original factory cabinet stencils, flawless original backglass (no flaking, bubbling, or fading), and crisp, un-faded playfield plastics. Museum-Quality Playfield: Zero typical EM playfield wear. The paint around the high-traffic pop bumpers, inserts, and shooter lane is entirely intact, preserving the vibrant, classic hand-drawn artwork. Fully Maintained & Functional: Meticulously serviced, cleaned, and dialed-in by a knowledgeable collector. Every switch, light, chime, and mechanical function works flawlessly. The Golden Era of Boxing: Released in 1975, this iconic boxing-themed machine captured the global hype of the sport during the legendary era of Muhammad Ali and the "Thrilla in Manila." The Elvis Connection: This exact model holds a famous spot in pop-culture history as one of the personal pinball machines owned by Elvis Presley, prominently kept and played in his trophy room at Graceland. Extreme Production Rarity: Bally only manufactured 2,085 total units of Knockout. Given commercial wear and tear over the decades, a surviving specimen in this condition is fundamentally rare. 2750 obo or open to possible trades

ads.title: 1972 Gottlieb Grand Slam Pinball Machine – Restoration Project – $500 OBO
ads.description: Selling a 1972 Gottlieb Grand Slam pinball machine as a restoration/project machine. My mother purchased this years ago with the intention of having it restored, but she never got around to it. It has been sitting in her garage ever since, and at this point we would just like to get it out of the garage and into the hands of someone who wants to restore it. The machine is currently partially disassembled and being sold as-is. I have not attempted to get it running and cannot speak to what it would need mechanically or whether every single original piece is present. Please look through the photos and feel free to come inspect it before purchasing. From what I’ve found, this is the 1972 D. Gottlieb & Co. Grand Slam, an electro-mechanical baseball-themed machine. Restored examples can sell for considerably more in the few thousands, but we’re pricing this one as a project and looking for a relatively quick sale. Asking $500 OBO — willing to negotiate. Pickup only in Fort Mill, South Carolina. Buyer will need to be able to transport it. Sorry the current pictures aren’t the greatest — there is cardboard and other stuff around/on the machine from it being stored in the garage. If you’re seriously interested, I can remove everything and take more detailed pictures, or you’re welcome to come see it in person as said. Here is the exact model (I think) for reference, including photos of what the complete machine looks like: https://pinside.com/pinball/machine/grand-slam-gottlieb-1972 Message me if interested or if you’d like additional pictures.

ads.author: Brandon Harris
ads.title: Bally Golden Gate Pinball Machine w/ Cabinet Backglass Art
ads.description: 1962 Bally Golden Gate Bingo Pinball Machine – Original – Untested For sale is an original 1962 Bally Golden Gate Bingo Pinball Machine. This is a great old survivor that appears to be largely complete and still retains its original playfield, Golden Gate backglass, cabinet, wiring, relays and internal electromechanical components. The artwork on this machine is fantastic and displays extremely well for being over 60 years old. It has the classic Bally Magic-Screen style gameplay and colorful Golden Gate/San Francisco themed artwork. IMPORTANT CONDITION NOTE: This machine has NOT been plugged in or tested in any way. It was found along with several other vintage bingo machines. Some of the other machines from the same group would partially light up and operate when powered, but this particular machine has not been hooked to power, so I am selling it strictly AS-IS / UNTESTED. I have not attempted to clean, repair or restore the electrical or mechanical components. Details: * Bally Manufacturing Co. * Golden Gate * Circa 1962 * Original electromechanical bingo pinball machine * Original playfield * Original Golden Gate backglass * Large amount of original internal wiring and mechanisms still present * Original wood/metal cabinet * Unrestored condition * Untested * Sold as-is There is age-related wear, dirt, scratches, paint loss and other cosmetic wear throughout as shown in the photos. Please look closely at all pictures for condition. These old Bally bingo machines are incredibly complicated electromechanical machines and are getting increasingly difficult to find complete and untouched. Great restoration project, collector machine, game-room display or piece of early coin-operated amusement history. Due to the size and weight, local pickup only. Buyer is responsible for inspecting the machine and determining operating condition. No guarantees are made regarding functionality.
